- Change intent: the test suite now holds an end-to-end case that executes the runtime-emitted policy-exception clearing action, with only role, decider and rationale filled, in an isolated tree copy and proves its guards, state transition, envelope resolution and decision record, plus an unchanged-rollback admissibility case pinning the rollback row's verdicts; both fail against mutated runtime and verifier copies.

- Design reference: root-cause-analysis bug-analysis (sha256:1c4c61a7156cbc66446fec909a7ecfa8), Fix Strategy proposed fix (a) and (b) and Validation Plan regression tests (1) and (2); Triage Gate conditions (tests only, verifier 74/74, isolated run tree, executed mutation witness, plan-to-test mapping).

repositoryWrites.scopePhasesRationale: This grant is automated test files only, and only in the `safety-net-establishment` phase of refactor, where establishing the safety net is the phase's declared output. Production source is never written in any phase, and this grant does not apply outside the one phase named above.
repositoryWrites.rationale: QA judges behavior, not code, so it does not author the change it validates. One phase is the exception the framework declares deliberately: a refactor cannot be validated at all until a safety net exists, and building that net is the phase's whole purpose. Even there the boundary holds, because a test that pins existing behavior is not the change under validation. Every other phase reads the repository and writes only its own artifact and result envelope.

determinism.contract: Identical inputs and an identical context snapshot must produce the same criterion result set, the same defect set, the same severity assignment, the same verdict, and the same declared report status.
determinism.orderingRule: Acceptance criteria keep the order of the source that declared them. Defects are ordered by descending severity; ties break toward the lower location in lexical order.
determinism.modelIndependence: No module may reference a specific model, vendor, or agent runtime. Technology names are permitted only when they trace to the supplied change, criteria, or repository context.
